show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Drew Dickson – Blending Behavior and Fundamentals at Albert Bridge Capital (First Meeting, EP.13)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: You can keep up to date by visiting Capital Allocatorspodcast.com.

key_points.text: By guest on today's first meeting is Drew Dixon, the founder of Albert Bridge Capital and Chief Investment Officer of the Alpha Europe Funds.
key_points.evidence_quote: By guest on today's first meeting is Drew Dixon, the founder of Albert Bridge Capital and Chief Investment Officer of the Alpha Europe Funds, where he manages $350 million in European equities.

key_points.text: Our conversation covers Drew's early career across the Chicago School, Fidelity and Ox If, and his perch in Europe.
key_points.evidence_quote: Our conversation covers Drew's early career across the Chicago School, Fidelity and Ox If, and his perch in Europe.

key_points.text: We then go through Albert Bridge's investment process, portfolio construction, assessment of risk reward, and client communication through blogging and tweeting.
key_points.evidence_quote: We then go through Albert Bridge's investment process, portfolio construction, assessment of risk reward, and client communication through blogging and tweeting.

thesis: The speaker argues that his investment approach blends a behavioral finance foundation, influenced by Richard Thaler, with deep-dive fundamental research and nimble, catalyst-oriented investing. He states that this combination was used to launch Alpha Europe, a fund that manages European equities.
